product_thesis: Every scale must add a player decision, not merely a farther camera.

scale_ladder.player_decision: How much noise, injury, and carried value should I risk before extracting?
Which site is worth a scarce expedition and what outcome counts as success?
Which road, season, supply load, and fallback route make the journey survivable?
Which community or route should receive limited aid, trade, or protection?
Which cross-region window, faction corridor, or campaign objective deserves years of commitment?

batches.title: Planet scale identity contract
batches.product_problem: The same place cannot persist across local, tile, region, and planet views without one stable identity and deterministic seed namespace.
batches.owner_opt_in: Preload ScaleAddress.gd or copy its pure-data contract after choosing a production save migration. No scene integration is required.
exclusions: planet projection
production save migration
Sim authority
camera or HUD
claim of collision-proof hashing

batches.title: Expedition brief and causal debrief
batches.product_problem: Loot has no player-facing reason, partial success is invisible, and a collapsed raid can be mistaken for delivered progress.
batches.owner_opt_in: Use the pure brief/snapshot/outcome contract and enforce settlement_key once in an owner transaction. The two-phase adapter verifies a real MapTileLab terminal transition, only reads the model, and performs no second settlement.
exclusions: production quests or task tree
Sim inventory or resident mutation
CargoManifest reuse
production HUD or save schema
claim that final noise caused a particular injury

batches.title: Region atlas and persistent caravan route
batches.product_problem: A larger map must create an explainable route tradeoff and preserve caravan progress without making observation advance authority.
batches.owner_opt_in: Adopt the pure atlas/plan/transition DTOs only with full-receipt collision checks, atomic before-state CAS, a typed event ledger, a frozen road snapshot or typed replan, and a real production save migration.
exclusions: production Sim or save authority
complete region or planet projection
automatic mid-journey road migration
receipt as signature or authorization
second town or cargo authority

batches.title: Tile promise to durable local site
batches.product_problem: A region destination must compile to a distinct reachable tactical site, and revisiting it must preserve depletion without serializing or regenerating a second local world.
contributes_to: roof, door, loot, threat, and extraction reachability
revisit scar ledger and terminal handoff
batches.owner_opt_in: Rebuild immutable blueprints from canonical atlas promises, validate arrival against an independently owner-accepted journey-state receipt, atomically CAS the accepted site state from idle-before to active-after on enter and from active-before to idle-after on resolve, derive scars from a trusted action reducer, and commit scars with once-only expedition settlement in the same owner transaction.
exclusions: production Sim, save, cargo, or settlement authority
raw client terminal claims as authorization
trusted local action reduction and scarred-site materialization (RP-0005)
mid-raid player and threat checkpoint
automatic SpaceGraph injection
site scars inside region road or discovery state
receipt as signature or anti-tamper security

batches.title: Trusted local visit reducer and no-respawn revisit
batches.product_problem: A terminal summary cannot prove local actions, and a generated site cannot become durable world memory if depleted loot, neutralized threats, destroyed blockers, or known roofs respawn on revisit.
batches.owner_opt_in: Accept commands through the deterministic reducer, store the complete journal plus an owner-held latest receipt, enforce one (journal_id, sequence) result by CAS, validate the original RP-0004 enter and independent idle/journey checkpoints, and atomically commit active-to-idle scars with once-only expedition or cargo settlement.
exclusions: production Sim, save, cargo, or settlement authority
client receipt as signature or anti-cheat proof
stable-ID backfill into the current MapTileLab runtime
persistent surviving-threat tactical position or health
wall or immutable cell destruction
site scars inside region road or discovery state
automatic SpaceGraph injection

batches.title: Accepted cargo and aggregated settlement network
batches.product_problem: One scarce accepted caravan bundle needs a medium-term aid, trade, or fortification decision without creating duplicate live towns or trusting caller-authored cargo, arrival, and consequence claims.
contributes_to: owner scope and cargo checkpoint anchoring
non-dominated aid, trade, and fortification board
joint network and owner cargo proposal
batches.owner_opt_in: Persist independently accepted network, owner scope/cargo, and arrived-journey checkpoints; build cargo from receiver-owned state; then atomically CAS the network and cargo owners so only one sibling proposal can commit.
exclusions: production Sim, save, cargo, town stock, coin, resident belief, or settlement authority
client receipt as signature, capability, or anti-cheat proof
one-sided application of the joint network and owner proposal
continuous distant-settlement simulation
ruins or quarry promoted into settlement nodes
road, site-scar, or SpaceGraph mutation
automatic release of final pending intel at catalog exhaustion

batches.title: Planet campaign directives and delayed regional consequence
batches.product_problem: A planet view must allocate one scarce command slot across seasonal cross-region objectives without becoming a larger route map or treating an abstract directive as physical launch, arrival, or success evidence.
contributes_to: externally anchored command and region evidence
batches.owner_opt_in: Persist independently accepted campaign, command-owner, region-owner, and whole RP-0006 checkpoints; build command capacity and region signals from receiver state; atomically CAS campaign + command + origin for commitment and campaign + fresh target for delivery.
exclusions: production Sim, save, command, region, faction, settlement-network, road, cargo, or site authority
client receipt as signature, capability, authorization, or anti-cheat proof
physical launch, route, journey, arrival, completion, or success claim
globe projection, face adjacency, or distance inferred from authored register slots
one-sided application of either joint owner proposal
observation or wall-clock time advancing an epoch or consequence
automatic mutation of RP-0006 network state or SpaceGraph

batches.title: Multi-epoch faction covenant
batches.product_problem: Today's accepted faction promise must constrain a later planet epoch through a real honor, one-amendment, or withdrawal decision without inventing faction authority or treating an RP-0007 directive as physical success.
batches.owner_opt_in: Persist independently accepted covenant, RP-0007 campaign, faction-region, adapter, and whole RP-0006 checkpoints; derive faction access from receiver state; atomically CAS covenant and region owners while preserving R1-to-R2-to-R3 evidence continuity.
exclusions: production Sim, save, command, region, faction, settlement-network, road, cargo, or site authority
client receipt as signature, capability, authorization, anti-cheat proof, or owner checkpoint
physical travel, execution, completion, delivery, or success claim
dynamic production faction medoids used as stable covenant identities
one-sided application of any covenant and faction-region joint proposal
observation or wall-clock time advancing an epoch, due state, or covenant
automatic mutation of RP-0007, RP-0006, SpaceGraph, or production faction state

batches.title: Limited planet reconnaissance portfolio
batches.product_problem: One active covenant creates three future-support uncertainties, but scarce reconnaissance should force a visible two-of-three opportunity cost without inventing hidden truth, advancing time, or projecting one face's discovery across the planet.
contributes_to: exact RP-0003 through RP-0008 evidence envelope
joint belief and recon-capacity commitment proposal
batches.owner_opt_in: Persist independently accepted atlas, network, campaign, covenant, recon-capacity, report, and belief checkpoints; derive the evidence envelope from receiver-owned RP-0003 through RP-0008 state; atomically CAS belief plus capacity at commitment and only the belief owner at resolve or stale close.
exclusions: production Sim, save, belief, discovery, intel, campaign, covenant, network, road, cargo, faction, or site authority
client receipt as signature, capability, authorization, anti-cheat proof, hidden truth, or report accuracy proof
probability, confidence score, success chance, recommendation score, or scalar portfolio ranking
fog reveal, discovery, route, movement, arrival, completion, or success claim
face adjacency or evidence projected from face zero onto face two or five
capacity refund when the accepted campaign or covenant snapshot makes a committed cycle stale
automatic mutation of RP-0003 through RP-0008, SpaceGraph, or production resident beliefs

next_candidates.title: Multi-covenant fulfillment council
next_candidates.stop_rule: Only proceed when an external aggregate checkpoint proves at least two same-planet obligations coexist before an RP-0007 directive is committed, one real fulfillment slot cannot satisfy all of them, at least three plans expose different durable sacrifices, and exact downstream RP-0007/RP-0008 receipts can settle every plan without lab-owned faction or campaign authority.
